name: ui-tree.json
reason: Adds optional `localWrite` entries (`local?: LocalWrite[]`, 1 to 4 writes) and `fromLocal` reads on `setState` and `action` intents in `liveframe/1` (F1, F2); adds the optional tree `focus` mark (F4).
hostAction: None; 0.3.x validators reject `/local` and `/fromLocal` fail-closed and hosts still receive completed intents without either field.

name: tree-patch.json
reason: Inherits optional `localWrite` entries (`local?: LocalWrite[]`) and `fromLocal` reads on `setState` and `action` intents in patch `set` and `insert` nodes (F1, F2); adds optional `focus` (node id or `null`) to the patch (F4).
hostAction: None; existing patches and 0.3.x consumers remain compatible.

name: template.json
reason: Adds `$defs.localWrite` and optional `local` writes and `fromLocal` reads on `setState` and `action` intents in `liveframe-template/1` (F1, F2); adds the optional node `focus` template value (F4).

name: LocalWrite
reason: Names one renderer-applied local write (`{ key, value?, until? }`) attached to a host intent (F1).
hostAction: None; hosts never receive `local` writes in completed intents.

name: Intent
reason: Adds optional `local?: readonly LocalWrite[]` and `fromLocal` on `setState` and `action` intents (F1, F2).
hostAction: None; completed intents delivered to `onIntent` and `checkOffered` strip `local` and `fromLocal`.

name: shown
reason: Adds `shown()`, the read-only `shown` expression root: how many `when`-gated siblings are drawn, for an empty state without a round trip.
hostAction: None; additive export. 0.3.x validators reject `{ "$path": "shown" }` with `unknown-name`.

name: LocalWrite
reason: Re-exports `LocalWrite` from `@arnilo/liveframe/sdk` (F1).

name: Intent
reason: Widens `Intent` with optional `local?: readonly LocalWrite[]` and `fromLocal` on `setState` and `action` (F1, F2).

name: action
reason: Adds optional `local` write list, `fromLocal` argument map and manifest-local type parameter `<L>` to `action()` options (F1, F2).

name: state
reason: Adds optional `{ local, fromLocal }` options argument and manifest-local type parameter `<L>` to `state.set()` (F1, F2).

name: local
reason: Widens `local.set(key, value?, options?)` with `{ until?: "revision" }` returning a `LocalWrite` when `until` is set (F1).
hostAction: None; existing `local.set(key, value?)` calls are unchanged.

name: generate
reason: Adds optional `{ manifest? }` second parameter so generated modules can type `action` and `state.set` `local` writes and `fromLocal` reads against `manifest.local` (F1, F2).

name: TemplateLocalWrite
reason: Names one expression-valued local write attached to a template intent (F1).

name: TemplateIntent
reason: Adds optional `local?: readonly TemplateLocalWrite[]` and `fromLocal` on template `setState` and `action` intents (F1, F2).

name: catalog.json
reason: Adds a third event carry form, `{ array: { items, maxItems } }`: one scalar item schema and 1 to 256 items (F3).
hostAction: None; existing catalogs stay valid, and a 0.3.x validator rejects an array carry fail-closed.

name: Definition
reason: An event's `carries` may be `{ array: { items, maxItems } }`, a bounded array of one scalar type (F3).
hostAction: None; code that switches on `carries` should handle the array form before relying on `object`.

name: ImplementationProps
reason: `emit` on an array-carrying event takes `readonly Infer<items>[]` (F3).

name: UiTree
reason: Adds the optional tree-level `focus?: string` mark: the id of one always-rendered node that takes focus when a later revision first carries the mark (F4).
hostAction: None; a tree without `focus` is unchanged. 0.3.x validators reject `/focus` fail-closed.

name: TreePatch
reason: Adds optional `focus?: string | null`: omitted keeps the base's mark, a node id sets it, `null` clears it (F4).
hostAction: None; `diffTrees` emits it only when the mark changes.

name: Elements
reason: Element JSON gains the optional `focus?: boolean` field (F4). Element JSON gains optional `when` and `bind` (bindable props only) and `TreeIntent` events (F9).

name: SurfaceEvent
reason: Adds `focus-missed` (`no-element` or `not-focusable`), reported when a changed focus mark cannot move focus (F4).
hostAction: An exhaustive `onEvent` switch gains one case; otherwise none.

name: SurfaceSnapshot
reason: Adds optional `focus?: string`, the accepted tree's focus mark while the surface is valid (F4).

name: TemplateNode
reason: Adds the optional `focus` boolean template value (F4).

name: Store
reason: Adds the optional `putStateIf(placementId, scope, expected, next): Promise<boolean>` compare-and-set by canonical JSON, implemented by `memoryStore()` and `fileStore()` (G2).
hostAction: None; a custom store without the method still implements `Store`, and `handleIntent` writes it with `putState` as before. Implement the method atomically to make concurrent `setState` safe across processes.

name: HostEvent
reason: Adds the `conflict` reason to `intent-refused`, raised when `handleIntent`'s compare-and-set loses four times in a row (G2); adds the `source-pending` event, raised when a resolver answers `pending` (F5).
hostAction: An exhaustive `switch` over `intent-refused` reasons gains one case; a handler that switches on `type` gains `source-pending` or ignores it, as unknown types already are.

name: BrowserFixtures
reason: Adds optional `local`, `compound`, `fromLocal` and `focus` fixtures for the new `rendererBrowserSuite` cases covering local state, compound local writes, `fromLocal` and focus marks; `conformancePage()` also exposes `events()`.
hostAction: Supply the four fixtures (and the `local` keys they use in the test manifest); without them the new cases fail and name the missing field.

name: sourceOutcome
reason: Adds an optional second argument, `{ pending?: boolean }`; with `pending: true` the envelope gains a closed `pending` variant (`{ status: "pending" }`). Without it the returned schema is the 0.3.0 one byte for byte (F5).
hostAction: None; existing calls and capability documents are unchanged.

name: SourceResult
reason: Adds `{ ok: false, reason: "pending" }` for a source the host has not read yet; `renderPlacement` shows it as `{ status: "pending" }` to a source that declares the variant and fails the render otherwise (F5).
hostAction: None; a resolver that never answers `pending` is unaffected. Code that switches exhaustively over `SourceResult` reasons gains one case.

name: design-system.json
reason: Adds the optional recipe property `motion` (`none`, `fade`, `move`, `fade-move`): enter, exit and reorder motion of a node's root. Valid only on a root slot's `rest` recipe and requires a `transitionDuration` (F6).
hostAction: None; existing design systems are unchanged and project the same CSS. A 0.3.x validator rejects `motion` fail-closed as `invalid-document`.

name: Recipe
reason: Adds optional `motion?: "none" | "fade" | "move" | "fade-move"`. Valid only on a root slot's `rest` recipe and requires a `transitionDuration` (F6).

name: ResolvedRecipe
reason: Adds optional `motion`, resolved through the cascade like any scalar recipe property (F6).
hostAction: None; code that reads every property of a resolved recipe sees one more optional key.

name: recipeProperties
reason: Appends `motion` to the closed recipe-property list (F6).
hostAction: None; code that switches over the list exhaustively gains one case.

name: createDomRenderer
reason: The plain DOM adapter's factory (F8): runs `/react`'s registry check through one shared function and returns `{ mount }`; `mount(container, options)` draws a surface over the surface core with no framework.

name: implement
reason: Binds a primitive's definition to `draw(node, element?)`, which creates or updates the node's element; typed from the definition as `/react`'s `implement` is (F8).

name: place
reason: Sets a parent's child nodes to a list with the fewest moves, using `moveBefore` where the engine has it (F8).

name: RendererError
reason: Re-exports `/react`'s `RendererError` class (the same class), so a DOM host catches registry failures without importing React (F8).

name: DomImplementation
reason: The opaque binding `implement` returns (F8).

name: DomNode
reason: What `draw` receives for one node: the core context's fields, drawn children, child items and the portal (F8).

name: DomItem
reason: A child node with `render()` for its drawn element (F8).

name: Draw
reason: The `draw(node, element?)` function type (F8).

name: DrawHooks
reason: Optional `dispose(element)`, called when a node leaves the tree or its element is replaced (F8).

name: MountOptions
reason: `mount`'s options: validator, theme, design system, transparency, callbacks, limits, fallback and host classes (F8).

name: DomSurface
reason: What `mount` returns: `update(tree)`, `set(partial)` and `dispose()` (F8).

name: implement
reason: No type change: the internal `Props` helper the declaration names moved to a module shared with `/dom` (`src/surface/implementation.ts`), so the printed declaration no longer inlines it.

name: domRendererBrowserSuite
reason: The renderer conformance cases run against an app's `/dom` implementations (F8): `rendererSuite()`'s structural cases on the app's page, then `rendererBrowserSuite()`'s cases without hydration. The cases are defined once for both adapters.

name: domConformancePage
reason: The app-owned page host for `/dom`: mounts one surface with the app's DOM implementations and exposes the `window.liveframeConformance` API the suite drives (F8).

name: DomSuiteOptions
reason: `domRendererBrowserSuite()`'s options: catalog, validator inputs, DOM implementations, themes, design systems, examples, fixtures, `page()` and `url` (F8).

name: DomPageOptions
reason: `domConformancePage()`'s options, with `fallback: () => Element` (F8).

name: BrowserFixtures
reason: Re-exports `/conformance/react`'s fixture type, shared by both suites (F8).

name: Styles
reason: Re-exports `/conformance/react`'s style-identity type, shared by both pages (F8).

name: PageOptions
reason: No type change: its theme, design-system and validator fields come from a type shared with `/conformance/dom` (`src/conformance/renderer/page.ts`), so the printed declaration names it.

name: rendererSuite
reason: No type change: the cases moved to a module shared with `/conformance/dom`, and the options parameter is no longer destructured in the printed declaration. Case names, order and outcomes are unchanged.

name: ephemeralManifest
reason: Adds optional `local` and `initialLocal` (both or neither) so element JSON may carry `when`, `bind` and local intents against the caller's local schema (F9).

name: generateElementsSchema
reason: Adds optional `{ local? }`: with it, the schema describes `when`, `bind`, the tree expression grammar and local intents; without it the output is byte-identical (F9).

name: ElementsSchemaOptions
reason: The options type of `generateElementsSchema` (F9).

name: createAuthoring
reason: `generatedTypes` takes an optional `local` object schema with `module: "elementsSchema"` or `"digest"`, giving `liveframe gen --elements-schema --local` (F9), and accepts `module: "digest"`, giving `liveframe gen --digest` from the server's catalog and capabilities (F10).

name: generateDigest
reason: A deterministic Markdown description of a catalog, and optionally its capabilities and `local` schema, for an agent that writes element JSON without MCP; over `budget` it throws `LiveframeFailure` (F10).

name: DigestOptions
reason: The options type of `generateDigest` (F10).

name: checkUrl
reason: Exposes the `url` keyword's check (spec §5) to trusted implementations that draw a link from text, such as the starter's `richText` (F12).

name: UrlRule
reason: Names the rule `checkUrl` takes: the allowed schemes and whether a relative reference passes (F12).

name: renderElements
reason: Malformed element JSON reports unknown-component for a missing, empty or non-string kind and invalid-children for non-array children.
hostAction: Update handlers that match invalid-prop for these inputs.

name: streamElements
reason: Malformed element JSON reports unknown-component for a missing, empty or non-string kind and invalid-children for non-array children.
hostAction: Update handlers that match invalid-prop for these inputs.
